No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this session we help students run a sustainable evidence-led heritage club.

All materials are provided. The session is adapted to your space, your timetable and the age of the participants.

What it covers

  • Choose local heritage question
  • Create field-observation cards
  • Plan school event and safeguarding
  • Present club charter

How the time is spent

  1. Choose local heritage question 25 min

  2. Create field-observation cards 50 min

  3. Plan school event and safeguarding 65 min

  4. Present club charter 40 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
